steps.title: Academic Korean
steps.body: Korea places enormous emphasis on education (교육열 — literally 'education fever'). Academic vocabulary is essential whether you're studying at a Korean university, taking a TOPIK exam, or reading academic materials. The education system is highly competitive, with 대학교 (university) entrance being a major life milestone.

tip.label: TOPIK & University
tip.text: TOPIK (Test of Proficiency in Korean) is the official Korean language exam used worldwide for university admission and job applications. Academic vocabulary appears heavily in TOPIK Level 3+. Learning these words boosts your reading comprehension significantly.

steps.meaning: Professor — 교수님께 질문이 있어요 (I have a question for the professor)
steps.meaning_ja: 教授 ― 교수님께 질문이 있어요（教授に質問があります）

steps.meaning: Lecture / class — 강의가 재미있어요 (The lecture is interesting)
steps.meaning_ja: 講義 ― 강의가 재미있어요（講義が面白いです）

steps.meaning: Class / lesson — 수업 있어요? (Do you have class?)
steps.meaning_ja: 授業 ― 수업 있어요？（授業がありますか？）

steps.meaning: Assignment / homework — 과제 마감이 언제예요? (When is the assignment due?)
steps.meaning_ja: 課題 / 宿題 ― 과제 마감이 언제예요？（課題の締め切りはいつですか？）

steps.meaning: Exam / test — 시험 잘 봤어요? (Did you do well on the exam?)
steps.meaning_ja: 試験 ― 시험 잘 봤어요？（試験はうまくいきましたか？）

steps.meaning: Score / grade — 점수가 잘 나왔어요 (My score came out well)
steps.meaning_ja: 点数 / 成績 ― 점수가 잘 나왔어요（点数がよく出ました）

steps.meaning: Major (field of study) — 전공이 뭐예요? (What is your major?)
steps.meaning_ja: 専攻 ― 전공이 뭐예요？（専攻は何ですか？）

steps.meaning: Enrollment / matriculation — 입학 축하해요! (Congratulations on your enrollment!)
steps.meaning_ja: 入学 ― 입학 축하해요！（入学おめでとうございます！）

steps.meaning: Graduation — 졸업을 축하해요! (Congratulations on your graduation!)
steps.meaning_ja: 卒業 ― 졸업을 축하해요！（卒業おめでとうございます！）

steps.meaning: Scholarship — 장학금을 받았어요 (I received a scholarship)
steps.meaning_ja: 奨学金 ― 장학금을 받았어요（奨学金をもらいました）

steps.meaning: Library — 도서관에서 공부해요 (I study at the library)
steps.meaning_ja: 図書館 ― 도서관에서 공부해요（図書館で勉強します）

steps.meaning: Research — 연구 주제가 뭐예요? (What is your research topic?)
steps.meaning_ja: 研究 ― 연구 주제가 뭐예요？（研究テーマは何ですか？）

steps.meaning: Academic paper / thesis — 논문 쓰고 있어요 (I'm writing my thesis)
steps.meaning_ja: 論文 ― 논문 쓰고 있어요（論文を書いています）

steps.meaning: Dormitory — 기숙사에 살아요 (I live in the dorm)
steps.meaning_ja: 寮 ― 기숙사에 살아요（寮に住んでいます）

steps.title: Academic Korean Complete!
steps.message: Excellent work! Academic Korean opens doors to Korean universities, TOPIK certification, and intellectual conversations. 열심히 공부하세요! (Study hard!)
